goal: Generate one auditable three-level business classification path for every Obsidian RawRef while keeping entity, project, person, and department links as secondary dimensions.

acceptance_criteria.description: The canonical taxonomy has exactly three levels and covers 产品、项目、客户、合同、交付、售后、财务、行政、人事、技术、市场、待人工确认.
Every classified RawRef receives level ids, labels, a stable path, status, confidence, and evidence; unmatched or tied rules go to 待人工确认 instead of being forced into a business category.
The generated vault contains a root taxonomy index plus level-1, level-2, and level-3 bridge pages, and leaf pages link to their RawRefs.
RawRef frontmatter and note links expose the same three-level classification path without modifying NAS source files or data/nas_memory.db.
User-confirmed ownership rules classify 五菱产品族、柳汽产品族、执行部门筹备组（including 礼品与物料）、and AI应用组 server maintenance before falling back to manual review.

boundaries.source_data: Read data/nas_memory.db and NAS source files without mutation.
boundaries.generated_output: Write only generated Obsidian pages under the configured vault root.
boundaries.fallback_policy: Unmatched and tied classifications must use the 待人工确认 branch with evidence explaining why.
